name: Who handles the plumbing and electrical work during countertop replacement?

mainEntity.name: Who handles the plumbing and electrical work during countertop replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing your countertops requires disconnecting and reconnecting plumbing supply lines, garbage disposals, and sink drains, as well as handling cooktop electrical or gas hookups. Leaving this uncoordinated can leave your kitchen unusable for days after the stone is set. Working with a hands-on general contractor avoids this issue. For example, HH Remodeling provides a single point of contact by leading the interior carpentry and finish work while coordinating licensed sub-trades to ensure water and gas lines are safely detached before removal and promptly reconnected after installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbing and appliance hookups require coordination with skilled sub-trades, which a general contractor manages alongside the physical countertop installation.
